lede: Edmonton had last change, so Mike Babcock picked most of these matchups. Edmonton played without Trent Frederic and Mattias Ekholm. Toronto played without Nick Blankenburg.

notes.head: McDavid’s line drew Matthews’s line
notes.text: Mike Babcock sent Podkolzin, McDavid and Draisaitl out for 11:30 of their 14:40 at 5-on-5 against Cowan, Matthews and Roslovic (78%, about 28% with no line matching), and the chances were close, 1.00 to 0.99 expected goals. Toronto scored two of its seven goals then.

notes.head: Nugent-Hopkins’s line drew Nylander’s line
notes.text: Hyman, Nugent-Hopkins and Kapanen spent 8:50 of their 13:45 at 5-on-5 against Marchenko, Paul and Nylander (64%, about 29% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.17 to 0.27 expected goals. Toronto scored one of its seven goals then.

notes.head: The third line drew Sissons’s line
notes.text: Formenton, Michaels and Joseph spent 6:30 of their 12:50 at 5-on-5 against McKenna, Sissons and Lettieri (51%, about 22% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.02 to 0.29 expected goals. Toronto scored one of its seven goals then.

foot: Mike Babcock matched about as hard as in his other home games: each line spent 61% of its time against one opposing line, against 36% to 67% in his first five.
